caption: The drawing shows two powder horns positioned parallel to each other, both oriented with their narrower, closed ends pointing to the right. The horns are curved and taper from a wider base on the left to a pointed tip on the right. The color of the horns is a gradient of light beige to a slightly darker brown along the outer curve, with shading used to indicate their three-dimensional shape. Both horns have carved decorations on their surfaces, depicting figures and animals. The base of each horn is capped with a piece of dark brown material, one of which (the lower horn) features a crescent moon and a star symbol in contrasting light colors. The tips of both horns are fitted with faceted, brown stoppers. The drawing is outlined by a single-line border and signed “Annie R. Johnston” in the lower right corner. The background is a plain, off-white color.
title: Powder Horn
